name: Fake Bank Alert SMS
description: Scammers send urgent texts about account issues to steal your login details and money.
redFlags: Urgent message about a blocked or suspicious account
A link to verify your details or a number to call back
Sent from an unknown number or a name that only looks like your bank
whatToDo: Do not click the link or reply. Contact your bank using the number on your card or in its official app, then delete the message and report it as spam.

name: Wrong Number WhatsApp Scam
description: Scammers use random numbers to start conversations and gain your trust, then ask for money or personal information.
redFlags: A message from an unknown number pretending to have the wrong contact
The stranger quickly turns friendly and keeps the chat going
Soon asks for money, gift cards, an investment or a verification code
whatToDo: Do not share personal details or money. Block and report the number in WhatsApp, and never send anyone a verification code.

name: Fake Delivery Notice
description: You receive a fake message about a missed delivery, with a link to pay a fee or update your details.
redFlags: You are not expecting a package
A link asking you to pay a small fee or confirm your address
A web address that looks slightly different from the real courier
whatToDo: Do not tap the link. Check the order directly in the courier's official app or website, then delete the message.

name: Fake Tech Support Call
description: Scammers pretend to be from tech support, tricking you into giving remote access or payment for fake repairs.
redFlags: A call you did not ask for, claiming your device has a virus
Pressure to act immediately
A request for remote access to your device, or payment by gift card or transfer
whatToDo: Hang up. Real tech companies do not cold-call about viruses. Never give remote access. If you already did, disconnect from the internet and change your passwords.

name: Phishing Email
description: Fraudulent emails that look real, aiming to steal your passwords, financial details or personal information.
redFlags: The sender address does not match the real company
A generic greeting and spelling mistakes
Links or attachments you were not expecting, with a request to log in
whatToDo: Do not click links or open attachments. Type the company's web address yourself to check your account, and report the email as phishing.

name: Impersonation Scam
description: Scammers pretend to be a friend, company or official account to get you to send money or share sensitive data.
redFlags: A friend or company contacts you from a new number or account
An urgent request for money or personal data
The person avoids a call or video chat to prove who they are
whatToDo: Contact the real person on their usual number, or the company through its official channel, before sending anything.

name: Prize / Lottery Scam
description: You're told you've won a prize, but you need to pay a fee or share details to claim it.
redFlags: You are told you won a contest you never entered
You must pay a fee or tax to collect the prize
Pressure to act quickly and keep it secret
whatToDo: Do not pay or share your details. Real prizes never require you to pay first. Hang up and block the number.

name: Fake Job Offer
description: Scammers promise easy remote jobs and high pay, then ask for upfront fees or personal information.
redFlags: Very high pay for very little work
You are asked to pay for training, registration or equipment
The recruiter only uses chat apps and avoids a proper interview
whatToDo: Do not pay to get a job. Check the company on its official website, look for reviews, and walk away if they ask for money.

name: Account Suspension Scam
description: You get a message saying your account will be suspended unless you verify your details immediately.
redFlags: A message saying your account will be closed unless you act now
A link to a page asking for your password or card details
A sender address or web address that is slightly wrong
whatToDo: Do not use the link. Open the service's official app or website yourself to check your account, and change your password if you already entered it.
